items: Iron spear or better (You will lose the spear)
Ranged or Magic equipment to kill a level 3 monkey
Any logs to make a fire
rec: Extra Raw Karambwans in case you burn the one given
Dramen staff if you have access to fairy rings
Sliced Banana (Use a knife on a banana)
rewards: Ability to catch and cook Karambwans (after talking to Tinsay after the quest)
Ability to use Tai Bwo Wannai teleport scrolls
Ability to complete the smithing section of Barbarian Training

st.t: Climb the ladder in Timfraku's house, the north-west house of Tai Bwo Wannai with a quest icon, and talk to him upstairs.
s: Who me? Oh I'm just a nobody.
Your gratitude is all I deserve.
Well, some gold would be nice.

i: Iron spear or better (You will lose the spear)
Ranged or Magic equipment to kill a level 3 monkey
Any logs to make a fire

st.t: Using your small fishing net, catch atleast 23 raw karambwanji just south of Tai Bwo Wannai.

Go to the fishing spots south of the Brimhaven house portal and talk to Lubufu. You have to talk to him multiple times. You'll need to ask him twice about what he does, then talk to him to give him the karambwanji.
s: What do you do with your Karambwan?
I could help collect the bait.
You sound like you could do with the help.
What do you use to catch Karambwan?

st.t: Get a Vessel from Lubufu by asking what he uses to catch them multiple times. Drop it, and talk to him go get another, then pick up the one you dropped. You can get as many as you want but you need 2 to complete this quest.
s: What do you use to catch Karambwan?
Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.

st.t: Use a karambwanji on a karambwan Vessel to fill it.
Go east to Musa Point and buy some Karamjan rum from Zambo at the pub.
Slice a banana with a knife. You can get a banana from one of the trees in the plantation.
Add banana slices to the karamjan rum to make Karamjan rum with banana slices.
Talk to Tiadeche in east Karamja, near the fairy ring DKP. You can teleport off Karamja; the Karamjan rum with banana will not break.
Use a filled vessel on Tiadeche. Make sure to finish the dialogue with him and accept the karambwan he offers!
Talk to Tiadeche more, until he asks you to take a Karambwan vessel to his brother Tinsay.
Pickup some seaweed from Karamja's coast.
Get some jogre bones. You can kill the jogres south of Tiadeche.
Use a tinderbox on the jogre bones to set them on fire.
Wait for the bones to burn, then pick them up.
Use a pestle and mortar on a karambwanji.
Use the karambwanji paste on the burnt jogre bones.
You should still have the raw karambwan Tiadeche gave you. If you lost it or burnt it, fish another next to him with a loaded vessel (65 Fishing), or buy one from the Grand Exchange.
Long-press the pasty jogre bones and choose Use, then tap a fire. A plain tap would bury them. You can either make a fire yourself, or use the fire south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Cook the karambwan for a poison karambwan. Note you may fail this and need to try again.
Use a pestle and mortar on a poison karambwan.
Use the karambwan paste on a iron or better spear.
i: Iron spear or better (You will lose the spear)

st.t: Talk to Tamayu at the mine north of Shilo Village, north-east of fairy ring CKR, by the mining symbol on the map. Talk to him twice and watch the cutscene.
Use an agility potion (4) on Tamayu.
Use a poisoned spear on Tamayu.
i: Iron spear or better (kp) (You will lose the spear)

st.t: Go on a hunt with Tamayu.
s: Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan.

st.t: Kill a monkey to get its corpse, there are plenty of monkeys around Karamja and you will need either magic or range to kill one.
i: Ranged or Magic equipment to kill a level 3 monkey

st.t: Use your monkey corpse on Tamayu to have him skin it for you.
Use your seaweed on your monkey skin to make a seaweed sandwich.
Go to Cairn Isle, west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring CKR. Climb the rock slide (15 Agility) and cross the bridge. Talk to Tinsay and keep talking, giving him the items he asks for.
Use the vessel on Tinsay.
Go back to Tiadeche, just north-east of fairy ring DKP. Talk to him, then use the crafting manual on him.

i: Iron spear or better (kp) (You will lose the spear)

st.t: Climb the ladder in Timfraku's house in Tai Bwo Wannai and talk to him upstairs to finish the quest. The option you choose doesn't matter. Afterwards, talk to each of the brothers in their houses in southern Tai Bwo Wannai for your experience rewards and the ability to cook karambwan.
